import sys
import random


def main():
    seed = int(sys.stdin.read().split()[0])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 10)
    cap = rng.randint(1, 50)
    lines = [f"{n} {cap}"]
    for _ in range(n):
        lines.append(f"{rng.randint(1, 20)} {rng.randint(1, 30)}")
    print("\n".join(lines))


main()
